note: Gin Layout Builder Plus is an opinionated UI add-on to gin_lb. It has NO config, NO settings form, NO configure route, NO permissions, NO Drush, NO plugins and NO *.api.php. It requires gin_lb, field_group and section_library. Its core is a kernel VIEW subscriber (LayoutBuilderBrowserEventSubscriber, weight 45) that rebuilds layout_builder.choose_section and layout_builder.choose_block into field_group horizontal_tabs with per-item icons (theme hook gin_lb_plus_icon), and adds a 'Library' tab that lists every section_library_template entity via SectionLibraryTemplate::loadMultiple() as off-canvas import links. gin_lb_plus_form_alter() adds an 'Add to library' button (route section_library.add_template_to_library) to a node's ..._layout_builder_form and applies the gin_lb #gin_lb_form/glb-form treatment to the section_library add forms. gin_lb_plus_page_attachments() attaches library gin_lb_plus/core on valid Layout Builder routes via gin_lb.context_validator. Because the module stores no config of its own, the medium/hard cases are grounded in the section_library_template entities its Library tab surfaces: introspection reads back a template created by setup; execution creates the template the 'Add to library' button would produce, verified against live entity state.

evals.prompt: What does the gin_lb_plus (Gin Layout Builder Plus) module change about Layout Builder's 'Add block' and 'Add section' pickers, and which extra tab does it add when adding a section?
evals.expected_output: Its LayoutBuilderBrowserEventSubscriber (kernel VIEW, weight 45) rebuilds layout_builder.choose_block and layout_builder.choose_section into field_group horizontal_tabs with a per-block/per-section icon (theme hook gin_lb_plus_icon). On the section picker it adds a 'Library' tab that lists Section Library templates (section_library_template entities) as off-canvas import links.

evals.prompt: gin_lb_plus adds a button to a node's Layout Builder form. What is that button for, and which Section Library route does it link to?
evals.expected_output: In gin_lb_plus_form_alter(), on a node's node_<bundle>_layout_builder_form it adds $form['actions']['add_to_library'] - an off-canvas AJAX 'Add to library' link to route section_library.add_template_to_library (storage type 'overrides', delta 1), so the current layout can be saved as a reusable Section Library template.

evals.prompt: Which contributed modules must be installed for gin_lb_plus (Gin Layout Builder Plus) to work?
evals.expected_output: gin_lb_plus.info.yml declares dependencies on field_group (used for the horizontal-tabs picker UI), gin_lb (its parent - it reuses gin_lb.context_validator), and section_library (which backs the 'Library' tab and the 'Add to library' button). Layout Builder Browser is an optional-but-recommended companion.

evals.prompt: gin_lb_plus adds a 'Library' tab to Layout Builder's 'Add section' screen that lists reusable Section Library templates. Inspect this live Drupal site and give the label of the Section Library template that would appear there.
evals.expected_output: There is one section_library_template entity, labeled glb_plus_known_tmpl. gin_lb_plus's LayoutBuilderBrowserEventSubscriber lists these via SectionLibraryTemplate::loadMultiple(); you can read it with `drush php:eval` querying the section_library_template storage (or drush entity queries).

evals.prompt: On this site, which entity type does gin_lb_plus read to populate the 'Library' tab of the Layout Builder section picker, and what is the label of the single library item currently stored?
evals.expected_output: It reads the section_library_template content entity (SectionLibraryTemplate::loadMultiple()). Exactly one exists, labeled glb_plus_probe_tmpl.

evals.prompt: gin_lb_plus surfaces Section Library templates in its Layout Builder 'Library' tab and its 'Add to library' button creates them. On this site, create a section_library_template entity with the label 'glb_plus_exec' (type 'section') so it would appear in that Library tab. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a section_library_template entity, e.g. `drush php:eval 'Drupal\section_library\Entity\SectionLibraryTemplate::create(["label" => "glb_plus_exec", "type" => "section"])->save();'`. gin_lb_plus lists such entities in its Library tab via SectionLibraryTemplate::loadMultiple().

evals.prompt: In my Drupal site's Layout Builder, gin_lb_plus lets me save layouts to a reusable 'Library'. I want a library entry named 'glb_plus_exec' to exist so it shows up when I go to add a section. Make that library entry exist on the site.
evals.expected_output: The 'Library' entries are section_library_template entities. Create one labeled 'glb_plus_exec' (type 'section'), e.g. via `drush php:eval 'Drupal\section_library\Entity\SectionLibraryTemplate::create(["label" => "glb_plus_exec", "type" => "section"])->save();'`, so gin_lb_plus's Library tab (SectionLibraryTemplate::loadMultiple()) would show it.
